VERDICT: Approve three log-only instrumentation tracks: settle_hour feature-diversity diagnostics, tree-bypass reason-coded counters, and hierarchical shrinkage as read-only prior estimates.

REASONING: 14/14 splits on settle_hour signals the split selector (adaptive_tree.choose_split or equivalent) is only scoring one feature — likely a scoring bug or degenerate feature variance, which counters will expose. The silent bypass (missing axis_values key → flat fallback) is a correctness risk hiding real ARMed traffic as flat; it must be made loud in logs, not in behavior. Hierarchical shrinkage (child→parent partial pooling) fixes the 92/94 LEARNING problem diagnostically without touching promotion bars.

NEXT_STEPS:
1. In adaptive_tree.choose_split(): add per-feature candidate counters — n_features_scored, per-feature best_gain, per-feature reject_reason (low_variance, insufficient_samples, gain_below_min_split_gain). Log top-3 gains per split attempt so we can see why settle_hour always wins.
2. Add log-only candidate secondary features to the axis registry in adaptive_tree.build_axis_values(): minutes_to_settle, day_of_week, category, side, and rolling realized-edge by (series, hour) — emit as axis_values keys so future splits can score them, with zero change to gating reads.
3. In learning.py gate_decision(): wrap the tree lookup in a reason-coded counter — tree_lookup.missing_key, tree_lookup.no_armed_node, tree_lookup.armed_hit, flat_fallback_invoked — keyed by (market_series, axis_key). Add a log warning when flat_fallback_invoked fires with an ARMED node existing for a sibling key (bypass signature).
4. Add an assertion-style counter in gate_decision() verifying axis_values originated from build_axis_values() (e.g., sentinel key _axis_source stamped by build_axis_values()); increment axis_source.foreign on miss — log-only, never raise.
5. In learning.py (new function hierarchical_shrinkage_diagnostics(cell_stats, tree)): compute parent-pooled shrunk posterior mean per cell — shrunk = (n_cell*mean_cell + k*prior_parent)/(n_cell + k), k from cross-validated noise ratio — and log |shrunk − mean_cell| per LEARNING/PROBATION cell. Read-only; no writes to promotion or sizing paths.
6. Emit a daily digest counter: cells that WOULD flip promotion state under shrunk estimates vs. raw, to quantify whether the 92-cell LEARNING backlog is sample poverty or genuine flatness — purely informational.

CALL_BACK_IF: tree_lookup.missing_key > 5% of decisions, or settle_hour remains the sole split feature after 7 days of new secondary axes in axis_values, or shrinkage digest shows >30% of LEARNING cells would promote under parent-pooled priors.
